title: The Hidden side of selling
creator_credit: Arthur Swerdloff, Leon S. Gold and Roundtable Productions
brief_description: Shows how sales personnel can increase their sales by learning how to deal with those customers whose reactions are hardest for them to handle. Creates an awareness of the psychological problems and hidden influences frequently encountered but often overlooked in selling situations.
